# Historical public release metadata fixture

These are byte-preserved public manifest/signature assets downloaded on
2026-10-20 from https://github.com/aatuh/evydence/releases/tag/v0.1.0-rc.7.
The tag resolved to source commit `2f759100e723554e4e68e3ada712c923e391a17a`.
The signing policy records the manifest SHA-256 and public-key fingerprint.

The signature contains a public key, never a private key. These fixtures test
the narrow historical pin profile without provider calls; they do not establish
historical protected workflow execution, new SBOM coverage or keyless identity.
